worldcombat.skill.steelbeam.summary: Throws a beam of steel straight ahead, damaging and pushing the nearest enemy. After firing, it incurs self-damage based on maximum health whether it hits or misses.
The beam reaches %2$s blocks with a %3$s-block half-width. It attacks only the nearest enemy in clear sight within that lane, dealing about %1$s Steel-type special damage.
A hit attempts to shove the target %1$s blocks. Every use incurs self-damage calculated from %2$s of maximum health, even when it misses.
worldcombat.skill.steelbeam.temper.on: Tempered: self-damage uses 65% of its base fraction; power ×0.9, length ×0.82, width ×0.8, and two extra wind-up ticks. The resulting self-damage fraction is shown above.
worldcombat.skill.steelbeam.temper.off: Full shed: press the whole plate into the shot for more power, length and width, at the full health cost.
worldcombat.skill.steelbeam.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, cost %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.steelbeam.growth.0: From level %1$s the lance power steps up to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.steelbeam.growth.1: From level %1$s the lance power reaches %2$s and the health cost rises to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.steelbeam.use.0: Forge your own steel into one heavy lance
worldcombat.skill.steelbeam.use.1: Trade maximum-health-based self-damage for a strong ranged strike
worldcombat.skill.steelbeam.use.2: Hit the first body in front and knock it away
worldcombat.skill.steelbeam.preference.t: Enabled: self-damage fraction ×0.65, power ×0.9, length ×0.82, width ×0.8, and two extra wind-up ticks. Disabled: power ×1.1, length and width ×1.12, with the usual self-damage.
worldcombat.skill.steelbeam.preference.a: Above this distance the companion closes in before firing. Higher fires sooner and wastes the health cost more often.
Below this health fraction the companion stops firing (unless the target is nearly down). Lower spends health more freely and risks stripping itself to the danger line.
